command:
cat <<'EOF' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/tmp-hardening.service
[Unit]
Description=Remount /tmp with noexec,nosuid,nodev
DefaultDependencies=no
After=tmp.mount local-fs-pre.target
Before=local-fs.target
Requires=tmp.mount
ConditionPathIsMountPoint=/tmp

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/bin/mount -o remount,bind,noexec,nosuid,nodev /tmp

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
EOF
echo ---
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable tmp-hardening.service 2>&1
